about.title: Joint Research Units
about.description: The 'Cassava Research Center' of the Tropical Crop Variety Resources Research Institute, CATAS and the 'Long Haixia Team' of the School of Information Science and Technology, Hainan Normal University jointly carry out research on the 'Cassava Post-harvest Rot Intelligent Recognition and Area Prediction System', dedicated to solving key technical problems in the cassava industry.

research.title: Long Haixia Laboratory, Hainan Normal University
research.leader: Led by Professor Long Haixia, the team includes complementary experts such as Liu Bo, Yu Xia, and Ma Cuihua, featuring high-level talents like IEEE Senior Members and World's Top 2% Scientists. Currently has 2 doctoral students, 13 graduate students, and 3 undergraduates, divided into 4 research groups: Cybersecurity, Bioinformatics, Ecology, and Complex Networks.
research.platform: Key Laboratory of Data Science and Smart Education, Ministry of Education; Hainan Engineering Research Center for Data Technology and Application
research.project: Core Research Fields: 1. Cyberspace Security (Blockchain scam detection, Federated privacy protection); 2. Bioinformatics (lncRNA-disease association, Single-cell tumor drug response); 3. Ecological & Agricultural Intelligent Detection (Jackfruit/Orange non-destructive detection, Bird/Amphibian acoustic recognition, Cassava rot quantification); 4. Complex Networks & AI Theory.
research.papers: Published over 60 high-level papers in important domestic and international journals such as Computers in Biology and Medicine as first or corresponding author, including 32 SCI papers in the last five years.
research.patents: Authorized 11 patents and 15 software copyrights. Hosted 2 National Natural Science Foundation projects, 4 Provincial Foundation projects, and won 1 Hainan Provincial Science and Technology Progress Award.

team.title: National Cassava Germplasm Nursery (Danzhou) / Cassava Research Center
team.leader: Cassava Research Center / National Cassava Industry Technology System
team.platform: Main Responsibilities: 1. Cassava germplasm resource conservation, utilization and variety breeding; 2. High-yield cultivation technology research; 3. Post-harvest processing and utilization research.
team.project: Major Progress: 1. Surveyed, collected and preserved cassava resources, bred excellent new varieties, obtained new plant variety rights and national certified varieties; 2. Promoted the integration of 'Food-Feed-Substrate' (Edible recipes, Special foods, Leaf flour processing, Stalk substrate utilization, Bio-fermented feed, Full mechanization); 3. Deep cooperation with domestic and foreign institutions such as CIAT relying on the national system, supporting the winning of the National International Science and Technology Cooperation Award.
